question:
What will be value of

(1)/({0.0001191)}, if (1)/({11.91)} = 0.083963
solution:
**Given:**

 (1)/({11.91)} = 0.083963

**CONCEPT USED:**

Shifting of decimals = divide the number by 10,100,1000....... when one has to shift decimal to left side and multiply by 10,100,1000.......when shifting of decimal has to be done on right side.

**Calculations:**

__ ____1 __

 0.0001191

⇒ __ 1 __

 __000011.91__

 100000

⇒ __ 1 __ x 10⁵

 11.91

According to the question, 

⇒ 0.083963 x 105. 

**∴ The value of __ ____1 __ will be 0.083963 x 105. **

** 0.0001191**
